title: 2025 Tournament Schedule

sections.alt: Bowlers in whites delivering and watching bowls across a sunlit green, with houses and shade shelters behind

body: You may download a PDF of the approved 2025 Tournament Calendar here:
Note: Please address any revisions and questions to Anne Nunes SWD Tournament Director.

migrationNotes: The 2025 Tournament Manual PDF is already self-hosted in the repo, so its button points at /pdfs/SWD_Tournament_Book_01_26_25_02_06.pdf rather than the Squarespace copy.
The 2025 Tournament Calendar PDF has been copied into /pdfs/ and the link now points there, so it no longer depends on Squarespace.
The calendar embed returned HTTP 200 on 2026-08-30.
The embed heading '2025 Tournament Calendar' is descriptive; the source page showed the sheet with no heading of its own.
Iframe height was not usable from the source markup; 1000 recorded.
The page gives no email or phone for Anne Nunes, so no contact section was created.
A /2025-tournament-schedule rewrite still needs adding to vercel.json — outside the scope of this migration pass.
